items.headline: Tyson Foods plant closure adds pressure to cattle industry as local farmer looks ahead
items.summary: The Davenport Chamber of Commerce said the number of cattle in the country has declined by around 10% over the last four years, contributing to plant closures.

items.headline: Iowa State Patrol trooper injured in Stuart shooting is a Rock Island native, Alleman grad
items.summary: Trooper Chase Carruthers was hospitalized, and a woman was killed in the shooting on Tuesday. Carruthers has been with Iowa DPS since December 2025.

items.headline: Henry County, Illinois, Sheriff's Office to end partnership with Flock Safety
items.summary: Officials with the sheriff's office said there are eight Flock cameras around the county. Their partnership will end effective Monday, Aug. 31.

items.headline: Man charged with murder in Stuart, Iowa shooting that killed woman, injured trooper; victim remembered for her kindness
items.summary: Austin Reed faces charges of first-degree murder and attempted murder after a shooting in Stuart left Toni Elena-Ann Salazar dead and a state trooper injured.

items.headline: Businesses excited as Gateway Bridge project nears completion in Bettendorf
items.summary: The new pedestrian bridge will go over Middle Road, linking the TBK Bank Sports Complex area with the Iron Tee Golf corner.

items.headline: Moline appoints Barry Dykhuizen interim city administrator
items.summary: During Tuesday's meeting, Moline's City Council also formally accepted the resignation of former city administrator, Bob Vitas.

items.headline: Discussions cease over proposed data center in Maquoketa
items.summary: In a Facebook post, the City said it and its development consultant, Gronen, mutually agreed to cease preliminary discussions on the proposed data center.

items.headline: Muscatine Power and Water modernizing city power grid with federal support
items.summary: Muscatine Power and Water is upgrading its electrical grid, including moving power lines underground, with help from $1.3 million in federal funding.
